project.title: Faaruun Hin Callisu
project.english_title: The Song Will Not Fall Silent
project.logline: An elderly mother in Dembi Dollo plucks one string on her late son's dusty guitar and hears a new generation singing his melody back through the August rain.

design_intent.audience: Oromo youth and diaspora, families from Dembi Dollo and Wallaga, and anyone who carries memory through song.
design_intent.viewing_context: Mobile phones (9:16 vertical in family WhatsApp/Telegram chats and TikTok/Reels) and desktop/festival screening (16:9 horizontal).
design_intent.target_feeling: Quiet grief turning into unbroken pride—realizing a voice can be silenced, but a song outlives the silence.

style_block: rich painterly realism, textured charcoal-and-oil animation look, dramatic warm doorway light contrasting cool blue-gray August twilight, muted earth tones, soft 35mm film grain, centered subject framing for 16:9 and 9:16 safe crop, no readable text or watermarks anywhere

character.description: elderly Oromo woman in her late sixties, deep-lined weathered face, silver-gray hair tucked under a faded cream cotton headscarf, worn dark-brown traditional dress with subtle woven border, thin weathered hands
reference_prompts: character turnaround portrait, front and three-quarter view, neutral tender expression, soft warm side light, neutral mud-wall background
medium shot seated on a low wooden stool beside an old acoustic guitar, dramatic warm doorway light

tts.style_instruction: Speak as a warm, dignified elderly Oromo mother in her late sixties. Female voice only. Slow, unhurried, quiet grief warming into gentle pride at the end. Pause naturally at punctuation.

cues.caption: sparse solo acoustic guitar underscore, slow, tender, melancholic highland folk texture, soft distant rain ambience, minimal sustained notes, no drums, no strong lead melody, room for voiceover

warm acoustic guitar underscore resolving from melancholic A minor to hopeful relative major, gentle distant wordless hum texture, soft rain ambience, tender swell then calm fade, no drums, cinematic score

shots.reason: Anchor place, season, and solitude: August rain in a Dembi Dollo highland home.
shots.image_prompt: dim mud-walled Ethiopian highland room, rain-streaked wooden window on left, one bright open doorway in center-right glowing into misty green rain, low empty wooden stool centered in frame
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle camera push-in, steady August rain falling outside the open doorway, soft shifting mist

narration.om: Ammas Hagayya. Roobni Dambi Doolloo akkuma duriiti. Garuu sagaleen kee, kan mana kana ho'isu, hin jiru.
narration.am: እንደገና ነሐሴ። የደምቢ ዶሎ ዝናብ እንደ ድሮው ነው። ግን ይህን ቤት ያሞቅ የነበረው ድምፅህ የለም።
narration.en: August again. The Dembi Dollo rain hasn't changed—but your voice, the one that warmed this house, is gone.

shots.music_cue: rain ambience only, silence before guitar

shots.reason: Introduce the mother and establish the untouched guitar as the visual symbol of absence.
shots.image_prompt: centered medium shot of the elderly woman sitting quietly on a low wooden stool, an old dusty wooden acoustic guitar leaning against the mud wall right beside her
shots.motion_prompt: locked static camera, subtle slow breathing of the elderly woman, soft flicker of natural daylight from doorway

narration.om: Gitaarri kee bakkuma ati keessetti hafe. Ribbii ja'a qofaan, weedduu uummata keef falmu ittiin uumte.
narration.am: ጊታርህ ባስቀመጥከው ቦታ ቀርቷል። በስድስት ክሮች ብቻ ለሕዝብህ የሚታገሉ ዘፈኖችን ፈጠርክ።
narration.en: Your guitar still rests where you left it. With just six strings, you wrote songs that fought for your people.

shots.music_cue: single soft acoustic guitar harmonic enters

shots.reason: Show his cultural legacy beyond music: teaching children Qubee so they could write their own names.
shots.image_prompt: centered close-up of a dusty wooden acoustic guitar resting beside an open worn exercise notebook and a short piece of white chalk on a low wooden stool, warm dust motes in a dim shaft of doorway light, no legible text
shots.motion_prompt: very slow horizontal drift across the guitar strings, dust floating in light

narration.om: Ati weellisaa qofa hin turre. Ijoolleen maqaa isaanii akka barreessan, qubee Afaan Oromoo barsiiste.
narration.am: አንተ ዘፋኝ ብቻ አልነበርክም። ልጆች ስማቸውን እንዲጽፉ የአፋን ኦሮሞ ፊደል ቁቤን አስተማርክ።
narration.en: You weren't only a singer. You taught children Qubee, so they could finally write their own names.

shots.reason: Show tangible devotion: preserving a silenced voice on an old cassette tape.
shots.image_prompt: centered overhead close-up of her thin weathered hands gently tracing a faded blank vintage cassette tape resting on a woven cloth
shots.motion_prompt: locked camera, weathered fingers slowly glide along the cassette edge

narration.om: Namoonni kaaseetii kee dhoksaatti dhaggeeffatu turan. Anis kaaseetii fi dabtara walaloo kee ol kaa'eera.
narration.am: ሰዎች ካሴትህን በድብቅ ያዳምጡ ነበር። እኔም ካሴትህንና የግጥም ደብተርህን አስቀምጬዋለሁ።
narration.en: People listened to your cassettes in secret. I kept your old tape and notebook of poems safe.

shots.reason: Connect his craft to language and ink—words that outlived the writer.
shots.image_prompt: centered close-up of an open worn paper notebook with soft out-of-focus blue ink lines and doodles, her wrinkled hand resting gently beside the page in warm light, no legible letters
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in on the aged paper and resting hand, soft dust

narration.om: Qalama cuquliisaan jechoota kana barreessite. Gara Finfinnee osoo hin deemin, 'Haadha dhiiraa hin boo'in,' jettee naaf weeddiste.
narration.am: እነዚህን ቃላት በሰማያዊ ቀለም ጻፍክ። ወደ ፊንፊኔ ከመሄድህ በፊት 'የጀግና እናት አታልቅሺ' ብለህ ዘፈንክልኝ።
narration.en: You wrote these words in blue ink. Before leaving for Finfinnee, you sang to me: 'Mother of a hero, do not weep.'

shots.reason: The emotional nadir: the heavy silence of August 1996 hanging over the house.
shots.image_prompt: centered close-up profile of the elderly woman looking out a rain-blurred window into deep blue twilight, soft raindrop shadows cast across her weathered cheek
shots.motion_prompt: static locked camera, raindrops slide slowly down the dark window glass, subtle blink

narration.om: Garuu Hagayya bara sagaltamii ja'a, rasaasni Finfinneetti sagalee kee dhaabe. Gaafasii as, manni kun waggootaaf callisee hafe.
narration.am: ግን በነሐሴ ዘጠና ስድስት በፊንፊኔ ጥይት ድምፅህን አቆመ። ከዚያ ጀምሮ ይህ ቤት ለዓመታት በዝምታ ቀረ።
narration.en: Then in August ninety-six, a bullet in Finfinnee silenced you. Since that night, this house has lived in silence.

shots.music_cue: score drops out to near-silence and rain

shots.reason: The active pivot: she breaks the silence herself instead of staying passive in grief.
shots.image_prompt: centered medium shot of the elderly woman carefully holding the old wooden guitar across her lap, warm golden rim light from the open doorway illuminating her shoulder and headscarf
shots.motion_prompt: slow gentle push-in toward her and the guitar, she gently steadies the wooden neck

narration.om: Halkan kana garuu callisuun hin danda'u. Ani weellistuu miti, ilma koo—haadha si yaaddu qofa. Sagalee tokko nan yaala.
narration.am: ዛሬ ማታ ግን ዝም ማለት አልችልም። እኔ ዘፋኝ አይደለሁም ልጄ፣ የምናፍቅህ እናት ብቻ ነኝ። አንድ ድምፅ እሞክራለሁ።
narration.en: Tonight, I refuse the silence. I am not a singer, my son—only a mother who misses you. I will try one note.

shots.reason: Focus on the single physical gesture that reconnects past and present.
shots.image_prompt: centered macro close-up of one weathered fingertip poised on a single worn bronze guitar string over the dark soundhole, warm golden highlight on the metal string
shots.motion_prompt: locked camera, finger gently plucks one string, faint vibration

narration.om: Ribbii dulloome tokko qofa nan rukkuta. Isaan weellisaa ajjeesan malee, weedduu hin ajjeesne.
narration.am: አንድ ያረጀ ክር ብቻ እመታለሁ። ዘፋኙን ገደሉ እንጂ ዘፈኑን አልገደሉም።
narration.en: I pluck one worn string. They killed the singer—never the song.

shots.music_cue: one clear resonant guitar note rings and lingers

shots.reason: Land the core feeling: grief transforming into tear-bright maternal pride.
shots.image_prompt: centered intimate close-up of the elderly woman turning slightly toward the bright open doorway, warm golden light catching a quiet proud tear-bright smile on her lined face
shots.motion_prompt: very slow push-in, gentle warm glow brightening across her eyes

narration.om: Dhaggeeffadhu, ilma koo. Balbala koo duubaan dhaloonni haaraan, kan gaafas hin dhalanne, walaloo kee hundumaa beeka.
narration.am: ስማ ልጄ። ከበሬ ጀርባ ያኔ ያልተወለደ አዲስ ትውልድ ግጥምህን ሁሉ ያውቃል።
narration.en: Listen, my son. Beyond my doorway, a new generation—not even born back then—knows every word you wrote.

shots.music_cue: warm distant hum rises with acoustic guitar
